root_idea.summary: A root oriented toward fullness, completeness, abundance, and the absence of deficiency.
root_idea.development: The basic idea of fullness develops into abundance, an undiminished or complete state, and related applications such as abundant hair, complete hides, preservation of honor, and giving a due in full.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested passive participle is presented under its normalized dictionary citation form.

senses.definition: Complete and undiminished; full or ample, with nothing lacking.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction جَزَاءً مَوْفُورًا, it describes the recompense as fully complete or undiminished.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become full, complete, whole, comprehensive, or abundant; to be without deficiency.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of things, property, herbage, or collections of goods and furnishings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To preserve or guard someone's honor, dignity, or reputation unimpaired; to refrain from reviling or faultfinding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction with عِرْضٌ or a similar expression for honor and reputation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something full, complete, whole, or abundant, or to leave it undiminished.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes making a garment or skin whole, supplying food or property fully, giving someone the whole of a right or due, and leaving hair abundant; the related forms وَفَّرَ and أَوْفَرَ are cross-referenced to this use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To restore or return a gift to its giver, whether from contentment with it or from considering it little.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive construction concerning the return of an offered gift.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be regardful of what pertains to someone, honoring the obligations owed to him, and to maintain loving intercourse or companionship with him.
To direct one's purpose, intention, determination, or resolution toward something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction with عَلَى for focused intention or resolve.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fullness, completeness, abundance, or copiousness; abundant property, goods, or furnishings, and by extension richness or competence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe property, goods, or land whose herbage remains abundant and undiminished, and may be used more generally for comprehensive abundance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A quantity or style of hair collected on the head or hanging to the ears, with its extent described as reaching toward or to the earlobe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional designation in the terminology of hair length and arrangement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Full, complete, whole, abundant, or copious; also numerous when applied to people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to property, vegetation, land, recompense, hair, or a complete hide or water-bag; the listed objects illustrate its uses rather than restricting them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Large-eared or having a large ear-lobe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical application describing the size of an ear or its lobe.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The fourth metrical pattern of classical Arabic prosody.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical prosodic term, named in relation to the fullness of its metrical feet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Left or maintained in an excellent, sound, or unimpaired condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiomatic expression عَلَى أَحْسَنِ مُوَفَّرٍ.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers the intransitive fullness branch and the figurative honor branch.
Covers transitive completion, returning a gift, and preserving honor.
Covers the regard, obligation, and companionship construction.
Covers directing purpose or determination toward something.
Covers abundant property, goods, furnishings, and comprehensive abundance.
Covers fullness, abundance, richness, competence, and abundant herbage.
Covers the general adjective and its anatomical ear application.
Covers the idiomatic expression for an excellent or unimpaired condition.

cautions: The Quran occurrence is supplied as the inflected form مَوْفُورًا; the public headword is normalized to the passive-participle citation form مَوْفُورٌ.
The Lane cross-reference to اِسْتَوْفَاهُ belongs to the separately rooted wfy entry and is not treated as independent lexical evidence for this root.
